exposure: comorbidities (anemia, epilepsy, cardiac disorders, renal failure, diabetes)
cohort: Pregnant women or women up to 6-weeks postpartum admitted to an obstetric ICU in SMGS hospital, GMC Jammu, India, over a one-year period.
finding: ICU admissions are common among older (>30 years) multigravidae, with leading causes being obstetric hemorrhage and hypertensive disorders of pregnancy, which also account for the majority of maternal deaths.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was identified as a more common mode of delivery among women admitted to the ICU.
